Package ep.model

Interface CalendarItem

All Known Implementing Classes:
Event, StudyBlock
public interface CalendarItem
Anything that can be drawn on the calendar: a fixed Event or a generated StudyBlock. The calendar views and the filter only work with this interface, so both kinds of entries are handled the same way.

      default boolean overlaps(LocalDate date, LocalTime start, LocalTime end)

      date - day to test
      start - start of the range (inclusive)
      end - end of the range (exclusive)
